subtitle: The same SELECT, a different value, depending on who's asking

code:
CREATE MASKING POLICY hr.public.ssn_mask
  AS (val STRING) RETURNS STRING ->
  CASE
    WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() IN ('HR_ADMIN') THEN val
    ELSE '***-**-' || RIGHT(val, 4)
  END;
caption: HR_ADMIN sees the real value; every other role sees the last four characters only.
The stored value never changes — masking happens only as results return.
